_comment: Curated fuel overrides layered on top of the ERSA parse. These record local/operational knowledge that ERSA does NOT list (e.g. car-petrol Mogas at roadhouse forecourts). Applied by scripts/parse_fac.py during a rebuild and by scripts/apply_overrides.py against an existing DB. Per entry: set any boolean fuel flag (avgas/mogas/jet_a1/...), 'add_fuel_types' appends to the fuel_types string, 'override_note' is surfaced on the aerodrome data card (not stored in the DB).
